resources.name: prod-web-server-idle
resources.rootCause: EC2 instance has been idle for 45 days with minimal CPU utilization (<2%). Instance is still running and accumulating charges despite no active workloads.
resources.recommendation: Terminate the instance or use AWS Lambda for sporadic workloads. Consider using EC2 Spot Instances for non-critical workloads to reduce costs by 70%.

resources.name: legacy-db-oversized
resources.rootCause: RDS instance allocated for db.r5.4xlarge with 16 vCPU and 128GB RAM, but only using 5% of compute and 3% of memory. Provisioned for peak load that rarely occurs.
resources.recommendation: Downsize to db.r5.large (2 vCPU, 16GB RAM). Use Aurora Auto-scaling to handle variable loads. This maintains performance while reducing monthly costs.

resources.name: unattached-volume-gp2
resources.rootCause: 20GB EBS gp2 volume has been unattached from any instance for 60+ days. No snapshots or backups depend on it.
resources.recommendation: Delete the unattached volume. If data preservation is needed, create a snapshot before deletion.

resources.name: old-backups-unneeded
resources.rootCause: S3 bucket storing 450GB of backup data from 2022-2023. Backups older than 1 year per company retention policy. Using standard storage class instead of Glacier.
resources.recommendation: Transition old backups to S3 Glacier for cold storage (90% cheaper). Implement S3 Lifecycle policies to auto-archive after 90 days.

resources.name: unused-elb-classic
resources.rootCause: Classic Load Balancer receiving zero traffic for 45 days but still provisioned and incurring hourly charges.
resources.recommendation: Delete the unused load balancer. Consider using Application Load Balancer (ALB) if traffic resurges, as it's more cost-efficient.

resources.name: snapshot-outdated-2022
resources.rootCause: 35GB EBS snapshot created in January 2022. No instances depend on it and retention policy suggests deletion.
resources.recommendation: Delete outdated snapshots. Implement automated snapshot lifecycle to retain only recent backups.

resources.name: unused-elastic-ip
resources.rootCause: Elastic IP address allocated but not associated with any EC2 instance. AWS charges hourly for unassociated IPs.
resources.recommendation: Release the unused Elastic IP address or associate it with an active instance.

resources.name: dev-sandbox-always-on
resources.rootCause: Development EC2 instance running 24/7 even during non-business hours. Only used during weekday business hours by 2 developers.
resources.recommendation: Stop instance during off-hours using AWS Instance Scheduler. Or use on-demand startup with auto-shutdown scripts.

resources.name: idle-instance-n1-standard
resources.rootCause: n1-standard-2 VM instance in us-central1 zone with CPU utilization below 3% for 50 consecutive days. Instance remains in RUNNING state.
resources.recommendation: Delete the instance or migrate workload to Cloud Functions (serverless). Consider using Preemptible VMs for cost reduction.

resources.name: mysql-oversized-prod
resources.rootCause: Cloud SQL db-custom-8-32768 (8 vCPU, 32GB RAM) provisioned for peak capacity but average CPU <8%, memory <5%. High availability replication enabled but not needed.
resources.recommendation: Downsize to db-custom-2-7680 (2 vCPU, 7.5GB RAM). Disable HA replication for non-critical databases.

resources.name: unattached-pd-standard
resources.rootCause: 100GB persistent disk in us-central1-a zone unattached from any VM instance for 45 days. No snapshots reference it.
resources.recommendation: Delete the disk or attach to an active VM. Create snapshot if archival is needed.

resources.name: logs-archive-old
resources.wasteReason: Old log files in standard storage
resources.rootCause: 520GB of application logs from 2022 stored in multi-region Standard class. Logs older than 90 days per retention policy. No active queries access this data.
resources.recommendation: Move to Nearline or Coldline storage. Implement lifecycle rules for automatic archival. This reduces cost by 60-80%.

resources.name: legacy-lb-unused
resources.rootCause: Network Load Balancer provisioned but receiving <1 request/day. Backend services deprecated but load balancer not removed.
resources.recommendation: Delete the unused load balancer. Use Cloud CDN with Cloud Load Balancing for active services only.

resources.name: reserved-ip-unused
resources.rootCause: Static IP address reserved but not assigned to any resource. Reserved IP addresses incur hourly charges.
resources.recommendation: Release the static IP or assign it to an active resource.

resources.name: snapshot-test-old
resources.rootCause: 40GB snapshot created during testing in March 2023. Marked as test data but never deleted. No active backups depend on it.
resources.recommendation: Delete old test snapshots. Implement automatic snapshot retention policies.

resources.name: dev-workspace-unused
resources.rootCause: n1-standard-4 VM used for development but running 24/7 including weekends. Team only accesses Monday-Friday 9AM-6PM.
resources.recommendation: Use Compute Engine Shielded VMs with startup/shutdown scripts. Or use Cloud Shell for occasional dev work.

resources.name: prod-app-server-idle
resources.rootCause: Standard_D2s_v3 VM running in East US region showing <2% CPU utilization for 40 consecutive days. VM deallocated would save costs immediately.
resources.recommendation: Deallocate the VM during non-working hours using Azure Automation Runbooks. Or migrate to Spot VMs (70% savings).

resources.name: legacy-db-large
resources.rootCause: Azure SQL Database (Business Critical, 32 vCore) provisioned for peak load but running at 4% CPU and 6% memory utilization. High redundancy not needed.
resources.recommendation: Downsize to General Purpose tier (4 vCore). This maintains SLA while reducing monthly cost by 85%.
resources.codeExample: az sql db update --resource-group myResourceGroup --server myServer --name legacy-db-large --edition GeneralPurpose --capacity 4

resources.name: unattached-disk-premium
resources.rootCause: 128GB Premium SSD managed disk unattached from any VM for 50+ days. Premium tier is expensive for unused storage.
resources.recommendation: Delete the disk or attach to active VM. Convert to Standard SSD if archival needed.

resources.name: cold-data-archive
resources.wasteReason: Cold data in hot storage tier
resources.rootCause: 850GB of historical data stored in Hot tier blob storage. Data accessed <5 times per year. Should be in Archive tier (90% cheaper).
resources.recommendation: Move to Archive or Cool tier using Azure lifecycle management policies. Archive tier costs $0.018 per GB/month vs Hot $0.018.
resources.codeExample: az storage account blob-service-properties update --account-name myStorageAccount --enable-restore-policy false

resources.name: unused-lb-standard
resources.rootCause: Standard Load Balancer configured but associated backend pool empty for 60 days. No traffic processed.
resources.recommendation: Delete unused load balancer. Use Application Gateway for active services only.
resources.codeExample: az network lb delete --resource-group myResourceGroup --name unused-lb-standard

resources.name: unassigned-public-ip
resources.rootCause: Static public IP address allocated but not assigned to any network interface. Azure charges for unused public IPs.
resources.recommendation: Delete the public IP or assign to an active resource (VM, NIC).
resources.codeExample: az network public-ip delete --resource-group myResourceGroup --name unassigned-public-ip

resources.name: old-backup-snapshot
resources.rootCause: 50GB managed disk snapshot from August 2023 retained for compliance but never restored or validated.
resources.recommendation: Delete old snapshots. Use Azure Backup for automated, compliant retention with lifecycle policies.

resources.name: dev-test-always-on
resources.rootCause: Standard_D4s_v3 dev/test VM running continuously including nights and weekends. Used only during working hours.
resources.recommendation: Use auto-shutdown feature or deallocate after hours using Azure Functions scheduler.
